objective: State the complete end-to-end outcome, not merely the next task

environments.purpose: Name the build, test, clean-room, staging, or production purpose
environments.identity_and_privilege: Exact operator, service, elevation, and private-input boundary
capacity: Disk, memory, CPU, and time requirements

prerequisites.requirement: Exact product, feature, version, source, integrity, and license requirement
prerequisites.fallback_route: Approved fallback task or explicit no fallback
prerequisites.authority_needed: Decision or handoff required before satisfying it

private_inputs: State none or identify private categories without values

entry_criteria: All facts that must already be green
exit_evidence: Evidence required to activate the next wave

authorization_envelope.automatic_activation_rule: Chief of Staff may activate only the next covered task after accepted predecessor evidence and green preflight
excluded_actions: List all actions requiring a new Product Owner decision

unresolved: Every unknown must be resolved or explicitly accepted before status becomes ready
